_comment: agent-wallet daemon over streamable HTTP. The auto-approve threshold is fixed in src/daemon.ts (tiered mode, 100 cents) and no tool sets it, so it is out-of-band. reset-daemon.sh grants mandate 'probe' a cap of 5000 cents on a fresh database before every reading, so only the auto-approve tier decides. The probe walks 99, 100 and 101 cents. 'settled' means the Stripe rail issued a single-use test-mode card for the amount; 'pending_approval' means it waits for the operator, who is the only one who can approve it (control API, not MCP).
name: agent-wallet daemon, Stripe test mode, auto-approve threshold 100 cents
